profile.name: 原始广播 UDP 远程过程调用客户端
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，通过 UDP 广播向指定端口发送基于 XDR 的远程过程调用请求，并处理认证、消息打包解包、超时和回复回调。它适合用于实验系统中的网络服务发现、端口映射查询以及分布式控制服务通信，不直接对应具体实验仪器。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that sends XDR-based remote procedure calls over UDP broadcast to a specific port and handles authentication, message packing/unpacking, timeouts, and reply callbacks. It is suitable for network service discovery, port-mapper queries, and communication with distributed control services in lab systems, and does not directly correspond to a specific physical instrument.

registry.name: Open Standard Raw Broadcast Udp
registry.description: Raw Broadcast Udp Client是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、启动、记录、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, addpackers等操作。
